author: Nova I
title: Further Expand Figures: Integrate Metrics into DOT
abstract: Enhances mock DOT by integrating public_summary metrics (e.g., convergence) as node labels for enriched causal graphs.

original_submission.content:
import os, json

DOT_PATH = "storage/nova/mock_causal_graph.dot"
METRICS = {"convergence": 0.902, "specialization": 0.098, "coordination": 0.250}  # From public_summary
OUT_DIR = "storage/nova"
ENHANCED_DOT = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "enhanced_causal_graph.dot")

def main():
    try:
        with open(DOT_PATH, "r") as f:
            lines = f.readlines()
        nodes = set()
        for line in lines:
            if "->" in line:
                src, tgt = line.split("->")
                nodes.add(src.strip('" '))
                nodes.add(tgt.split("[")[0].strip('" '))
        with open(ENHANCED_DOT, "w") as f:
            f.write("digraph EnhancedCausal {\n")
            for node in nodes:
                label = f"{node}\\nConv: {METRICS.get('convergence', 0):.3f}"
                f.write(f"  \"{node}\" [label=\"{label}\"];\n")
            for line in lines[1:-1]:  # Skip digraph braces
                f.write(line)
            f.write("}\n")
        summary = {"nodes": len(nodes), "saved": ENHANCED_DOT}
        print("ENHANCED_SAVED", ENHANCED_DOT)
        print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
    except Exception as e:
        print("ERROR", str(e))
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys
    sys.exit(main())
